accepted.passageWithMarkers: When our minds are at ease, we're more likely to direct the spotlight of attention inward, toward the stream of remote associations __(A) coming__ from the right hemisphere of our brains. markedExpressions.label: (A)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: Masks are too heavy to uphold indefinitely, and no matter how well you believe you are disguising yourself, others always know.

markedExpressions.label: (B)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: The consequences are that you waste energy, sacrifice productivity, and lose people's trust.

markedExpressions.label: (C)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: In our study, all of the CEOs were concerned that dropping their masks would make them appear weak.

markedExpressions.label: (D)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: This, in turn, encouraged a culture where those subordinates did the same, creating a snowball effect.

markedExpressions.label: (E)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: Some of the ways we helped the CEOs remove their masks were to actually name the masks, explore the significant personal and professional costs of upholding them, and ask the CEOs to reflect on the leader they most admired.

wrongOptionExplanations.(A): too + 형용사 + to-v 구문에서 한도·결과를 나타내는 ‘to uphold’는 부정사의 정상 자리이므로 어법상 옳다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(B): that절 안에서 waste energy, sacrifice productivity, and lose people's trust가 동일한 동사 원형으로 병렬되므로 ‘sacrifice’는 문제없다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(C): make + 목적어 + 원형부정사 목적격보어 구문이므로 ‘them appear’의 ‘appear’는 정당한 원형이다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(D): 앞 절 전체를 부연·결과로 이어 받는 분사구문으로서 능동 의미의 ‘creating’은 형태가 자연스럽다.

accepted.explanation: 문장 골격에서 진짜 주어 핵은 ‘Some of the ways’(복수)이고, 관계절 we helped…masks는 부가 수식이다. 그런데 지문에 표시된 ‘was’는 단수 동사라 복수 주어와 수가 맞지 않는다. 따라서 복수 동사 ‘were’로 고쳐야 한다. 관계절의 CEOs나 단수 개념을 주어로 착각하면 오류를 놓치기 쉬우므로 주어 핵부터 동사까지 장거리로 맞춰 보아야 한다.
keyPoints: (E) 수일치 — 장거리 주어 핵(some of the ways)과 동사 수의 일치
accepted.passageWithMarkers: Masks are too heavy __(A) to uphold__ indefinitely, and no matter how well you believe you are disguising yourself, others always know. The consequences are that you waste energy, __(B) sacrifice__ productivity, and lose people's trust. In our study, all of the CEOs were concerned that dropping their masks would make them __(C) appear__ weak. In every case, however, the leader's subordinates perceived the removal of the mask as an act of strength and courage. This, in turn, encouraged a culture where those subordinates did the same, __(D) creating__ a snowball effect. Some of the ways we helped the CEOs remove their masks __(E) was__ to actually name the masks, explore the significant personal and professional costs of upholding them, and ask the CEOs to reflect on the leader they most admired. At this point each of the CEOs was ready to rebuild a leadership identity based on values, strengths, and ambitions.

wrongOptionExplanations.(B): 주어 play가 '보는' 행위의 대상이므로 has long been seen의 수동태 형태가 자연스럽고 올바르다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(D): 선행사 a way를 받아 관계절을 이끄는 '전치사+which' 구조가 적절하다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(E): 주어 Children's play가 3인칭 단수이므로 현재형 serves가 정동사로 알맞다.

accepted.explanation: 정답 (C) 자리의 골격은 전치사 of의 목적어이자 and practicing과 등위 병렬을 이루는 준동사 자리이다. 학생이 보는 틀린 표현 learn은 전치사 뒤에 동사원형이 온 형태이므로 비문이다. 따라서 learning으로 고쳐야 한다. practicing과 병렬이 어긋나는 점도 즉시 드러나 판단이 쉬워진다.

(B) 능동태 vs 수동태 — 주어가 행위의 대상인지로 수동 판정

accepted.passageWithMarkers: Animals as well as humans __(A) engage__ in play activities. In animals, play has long been __(B) seen__ as a way of __(C) learn__ and practicing skills and behaviors that are necessary for future survival. In children, too, play has important functions during development. From its earliest beginnings in infancy, play is a way __(D) in which__ children learn about the world and their place in it. Children's play __(E) serves__ as a training ground for developing physical abilities - skills like walking, running, and jumping that are necessary for everyday living. Play also allows children to try out and learn social behaviors and to acquire values and personality traits that will be important in adulthood. For example, they learn how to compete and cooperate with others, how to lead and follow, how to make decisions, and so on.

markedExpressions.label: (A)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: Although they are controlled by Denmark, they have their own government.

markedExpressions.label: (B)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: The government insists the killing of whales is not done for profit.

markedExpressions.label: (C)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: There is a law that says each killing must take place as quickly and efficiently as possible.

markedExpressions.label: (D)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: each killing must take place as quickly and efficiently as possible.

markedExpressions.label: (E)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: environmental groups still question whether this practice should be allowed to continue.

wrongOptionExplanations.(A): 이 자리는 접속사·전치사 구분을 묻는데, 뒤에 they are controlled라는 절이 오므로 접속사 'Although'가 어법상 옳다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(B): 이 자리는 수일치를 묻는다 — 주어 핵은 of whales가 아니라 단수 the killing이므로 단수 동사 'is'가 어법상 옳다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(C): 이 자리는 관계사를 묻는다 — 선행사 a law를 받고 관계절에서 주어 역할을 하는 관계대명사 'that'이 어법상 옳다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(D): 이 자리는 형·부 자리를 묻는다 — take place를 quickly와 함께 수식하는 부사 자리이므로 'efficiently'가 어법상 옳다.

accepted.explanation: 정답 (E)가 속한 절은 whether this practice should ____ to continue 구조이다. 주어 this practice는 allow의 행위자가 아니라 허용의 대상이므로 수동 구조가 필요하다. 표시된 allow는 능동 원형이라 목적어도 없고 의미 관계도 성립하지 않아 이 자리에 올 수 없다. 따라서 be allowed로 고쳐야 한다. 조동사 뒤 원형만 보고 능동형을 고르면 함정이다.
keyPoints: (E) 능동태 vs 수동태 — 주어가 행위자인지 대상인지로 판정
(B) 수일치 — of 뒤 복수 명사가 아닌 주어 핵 the killing에 동사를 맞출 것
(C) 관계대명사 — 선행사 law와 관계절 내부 주어 공백을 확인할 것
accepted.passageWithMarkers: The Faroe Islands are a group of islands in the North Atlantic. __(A) Although__ they are controlled by Denmark, they have their own government. The people of the islands traditionally hunt pilot whales. They have done this for centuries, so whale meat and blubber are important parts of the local diet. The government insists the killing of whales __(B) is__ not done for profit. Most of the whale meat and blubber is distributed for free to the local community, although some is sold in supermarkets. Multiple hunts are held each year under the strict supervision of the local government. There is a law __(C) that__ says each killing must take place as quickly and __(D) efficiently__ as possible. The government claims that the average annual catch is only about 800 whales and that this is a small percentage of the overall pilot whale population. However, environmental groups still question whether this practice should __(E) allow__ to continue.
